s01293.summary: Imelda and Winifred wait on a station bench in 1946 among sleeping soldiers.
Arthur arrives in demobbed uniform and recognizes Imelda, who stands, dropping the hat.
Imelda scolds Arthur for arriving four years late while he insists he is here now.
Imelda returns his father's hat; he puts it on and she straightens it.

s00654.summary: A hearse carrying a coffin of cash speeds through rainy night as the crew works.
Frayed nerves surface as Laurence demands silence and Mireille laughs it off.
Tandi spots trailing headlights, pulls onto the shoulder and kills the engine.
The car passes as a taxi; relieved, Mireille remarks on fear and restarts the engine.

s02361.summary: In the rainy tollhouse, elf Erlandel arrives and pays Brunhilde three silver coins.
Sprigget reveals Ulfric's silence since the flood; he answers curtly to the wall.
Brunhilde serves tea; Ulfric silently accepts his cup while Sprigget steals a coin.

s02479.summary: In the empty bowling alley, Sal, Duke and Barney wait for nervous Moses.
Sal and Duke needle sweating Moses about payment until he insists it is in the bag.
The bag holds only newspaper; Sal rises and Duke closes in on Moses.

s00782.summary: Lucia and Greta fight to stabilize wounded Abel in the ice rink hospital.
Paramedic Rafi bursts in with Abel's brother Kofi, who runs to him.
Kofi crashes into Greta, the tray flies, Lucia and Rafi fall, and Abel flatlines.
Lucia and Greta shock Abel with paddles until his heartbeat returns.
Shaking, Lucia criticizes Kofi's bandage, promises to redo it, and Abel wakes.

s00765.summary: Between rounds, remote coach Mel checks battered Priss and gives tactical advice.
Priss slips the hook, lands a right and left, and drops her opponent.

s00952.summary: Constance and Georgiana whisper about the staring Duchess at a Bath assembly.
The Duchess overhears, rebukes them as fools, and orders them to dance and smile.

s00148.summary: Masked Dmitri and Imelda break through the Ferris wheel gondola's roof hatch.
The wheel lurches; Imelda notes his slipped mask and they banter over names.
They whisper in unison, grin, and prepare to climb out onto the roof.

s01728.summary: Five stranded travelers assess a dead truck with a cracked fuel line in the salt flat.
Dev presses Jorund about whether the satellite phone actually works.
Jorund dials; Dispatch answers and promises a rescue team by ten.
Dispatch reports a beacon trigger and a second vehicle, which Dev and Anneliese spot nearby.
Jorund suspects Mox and orders his hands up as Mox steps out.

s00708.summary: Five guests are snowed in at a hunting lodge, with no phone signal.
Harlan demands to know who summoned them and why a guest is missing.
Quentin names the late guest Teddy Marsh; Basil drops his glass.
The front door rattles, Harlan tries the latch, and Quentin says that would be him.

s01631.summary: Okafor and Lindgren trade accusations of stalling before Judge Abernathy over a signed contract.
The knocking radiator briefly distracts the room before counsel are ordered to speak singly.
Okafor presents Exhibit nine; Lindgren shows the signature is Okafor's, who laughs it off.

s00552.summary: Walter watches Agnes fight a vending machine at four in the morning.
Agnes finally gets pretzels and shares them with Walter while they compare sick spouses.
Agnes admits she needs looking after; they laugh and sit together quietly.
Walter confuses his wife with Delia; Agnes gently tells him she is his wife.
Agnes holds his hand, suggests going back, and feeds the machine another dollar.

s01914.summary: The sky-ferry crew bickers over short tally and a missing pie.
Dame Oswytha enters the galley and delivers a sealed royal tube to Captain Zephyra.
Zephyra reads a full pardon for smuggling; Oswytha says the Crown wants to hire them.
The stunned crew laughs and Zephyra invites Oswytha to dinner.

s01802.summary: Sisters Ruth and Lorelei sit in uneasy silence at a night diner.
An unknown man in a soaked coat joins their booth and demands Ruth tell Lorelei about Dad.
The man reveals himself as Bernard, their brother; Ruth cries and admits she hid it.
Lorelei rises to leave, then orders Ruth and Bernard to sit.

s00957.summary: Riders on a mesa overlook demand the name of a rifle-bearing stranger.
The Stranger recognizes Sally and identifies himself as her supposedly dead brother Ephraim.

s01778.summary: In a grain silo, a ticking stops and a motionless stranger stands by the ladder.
The Stranger steps into the light and gives his name as Anselm.
The bulb dies; Anselm reappears and Max swings, but Anselm catches the bar as wheat rises.

s01242.summary: Old rancher Jeremiah whittles on his dry porch as a rider approaches.
Jeremiah directs the Stranger to the well, then invites him to sit.
The Stranger gives his name as Jedediah Pike, Jeremiah's long-lost son.
Jeremiah offers beans and hides his emotion; Jedediah finishes the carving.

s01499.summary: Two couples and a waiter trade glances in a revolving restaurant.
Solange reads the waiter's napkin note; Sabine grips Halvard's wrist and Dimitri reaches for his jacket.
Solange smiles and says the elevator has stopped, and the lights go out.

s01673.summary: Tobias pushes a stone on a ruined rink while the radio announces a title.
Mireille tells Tobias her team spot was filled; he deflects about the cold.
Mireille lays down her broom and leaves while Tobias stays behind.

s02055.summary: Holly challenges Jubilee over quitting; she explains she can't beat Ingrid.
Holly admits he listens through the wall; Jubilee bristles but doesn't push him away.
Holly's mother calls, and he admits he's helping Jubilee.
Holly persuades Jubilee to play; she opens the case and he counts her in.

s00111.summary: In a hanging silo elevator, Valerian pressures Dorothea to press the red stop button.
She presses the alarm, he lunges, they struggle, and the elevator drops and catches.
Valerian admits he sold the whole shipment to her brother.
Coldly pleased, Dorothea repairs the lever and raises the elevator to see her brother.

s00678.summary: Spud threatens Loretta over a pile of cash at a standoff in the bowling lane.
Gideon bolts, Spud hurls the ball and strikes, and Minnow cheers from under the table.

s01566.summary: The Warden of Salt meets Willa on the glass desert and asks her reason for coming.
Willa's lantern stirs the sand; the Warden shows her grandmother in the lens.
Willa steps forward, cracking the glass, and says she is older than she looks.
The Warden demands a season of Willa's life, spring, for an hour with her grandmother.
Both say yes, the glass clears, and Willa descends the stair alone.

s02015.summary: Inspector Clementine questions the housekeeper Prudence about the missing book.
Clementine notes Prudence had the key and hour; Prudence says she would have been caught.
Prudence reveals the book was never there; the cabinet is a decoy.
They share a smile; Prudence says the book is in the kitchen and goes to make tea.

s00865.summary: Mina pushes withdrawn Rowan to get ready for school while Gus asks her to let him be.
Gus offers to walk Rowan in, and Rowan lets Mina kiss his hair.
